immediate_generator.mudanca: No change. Its RV32I immediate generation remains correct for RV32IM.

register_file.mudanca: No change. The existing 32-register file, asynchronous reads, rising-edge writes, reset, and hardwired x0 behavior apply equally to RV32IM.

alu.mudanca: No change. This block continues to implement the existing RV32I operations; M operations are handled by a separate block.

decoder.mudanca: Extend OP decoding to recognize funct7 = 0000001 and all eight funct3 values as valid M instructions. Assert reg_write and a new m_enable output for those encodings, with register operands selected. Preserve all existing RV32I decoding and no-side-effect behavior for unsupported encodings.

muldiv.mudanca: Add a purely combinational RV32M execution block implementing MUL, MULH, MULHSU, MULHU, DIV, DIVU, REM, and REMU.

cpu.mudanca: Keep the exact existing top-level entity and ports. Integrate the changed decoder and one muldiv instance; route rs1, rs2, and instr funct3 to the M unit; select its result for writeback when m_enable is asserted. Preserve the existing RV32I datapath, reset behavior, PC sequencing, memory interface, and one-instruction-per-edge execution.
